### Research SWE (HCI × Generative AI) — Full-Stack Prototyping / UX / Creativity Support

> Research Software Engineer specializing in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI) and Creativity Support Tools powered by foundation models.
> I build and evaluate interactive systems end-to-end, spanning from ML/LLM backends to frontend UIs.
> By designing rigorous user studies and developing novel evaluation metrics, I translate research findings into both academic publications and real-world product innovations.

- **Keywords**: Human-AI Interaction, Music and HCI (Interactive System on Musical Experience), Natural Language Processing

## Education

### Research Engineering (Prototyping for Discovery)

- **Flexible Interaction Architecture**: Designing systems that allow rapid A/B testing of interaction scenarios and parameters, prioritizing exploration speed over scalability.
- **Micro-Interaction State Management**: Implementing complex state management for real-time, low-latency interactions (e.g., musical interfaces) that demand precise timing beyond typical web standards.

- Designing stories through interviews
